notes: In a group chat, one character can no longer answer for everyone. What each member reads is a transcript where every line from someone else is written as a name followed by what they said — and a model shown that format continues it, writing the whole room's replies inside one message, so a single character would stage the entire conversation and nobody else got a turn. Asking it not to was never going to be reliable, so a reply is now cut at the first line spoken in somebody else's name, and a character labelling its own message has the label removed. Whatever they genuinely said as themselves is kept, and mentioning another person in an ordinary sentence still works. The instruction is sharper too: the transcript is explicitly described as something not to copy.
